proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense mediation qualifier for through-item viewing
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing grant_sense atom can express Truesight, but the authored surface cannot constrain that sense to apply only while the bearer is peering through the specific gem.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem."

notes: Magic-item activation, charge pool, dawn recharge, and timed duration all fit. The only blocker is the missing surface qualifier for item-mediated sight; encoding unconditional grant_sense would be misleading, so no content JSON/trace was authored.
